title: The Subconscious Mind: The Connecting Link
coreMove: Guard the subconscious by choosing the emotions you rehearse: feed desire, faith, and hope, then cut fear, jealousy, and anger before they become plans.

exampleSpecs.audience: owners whose private worry keeps rewriting their plans
exampleSpecs.stakes: tomorrow's sales calls will repeat yesterday's fear unless the input changes
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show desire, faith, and hope being deliberately supplied as constructive emotional input

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders facing a room where private resentment is steering decisions
exampleSpecs.stakes: a staffing plan could be built from fear rather than fact
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: separate facts from fear, jealousy, and anger before the group plans

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who say brave words while expecting defeat
exampleSpecs.stakes: a request for guidance will be hollow if the emotional state contradicts it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show prayer becoming emotionalized thought before the next plan appears

exampleSpecs.audience: operators tempted to rehearse injury after a public loss
exampleSpecs.stakes: one lost bid can become a dominant emotional diet
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: interrupt fear and anger before they become the next operating impulse

exampleSpecs.audience: creative teams whose failed tests have drained belief
exampleSpecs.stakes: the next prototype could be guided by dread or by constructive emotion
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use the positive emotion list as a practical inventory before planning

exampleSpecs.audience: owners asking for guidance while feeding fear all day
exampleSpecs.stakes: a divided emotional message keeps practical ideas from forming
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show prayer failing when fear contradicts faith, then becoming aligned
